:::{#exm-divides}
#### Divisors and non-divisors

- $3$ [divides](#def-divides) $12$, $3 \mid 12$,
  because $12 = 3 \cdot 4$
  and $4$ is an [integer](#def-integers).
- $5 \nmid 12$,
  because $5 \cdot 2 = 10 < 12 < 15 = 5 \cdot 3$,
  so no integer $c$ has $5 c = 12$.
- Every integer $a$ [divides](#def-divides) $0$,
  because $0 = a \cdot 0$.

<!-- no-figure: three single divisibility facts -->

:::
